description: This file defines a utility class 'GLToolbox' providing static methods for managing OpenGL ES 2.0 shaders and textures in an Android application. It includes methods for loading shaders, creating shader programs, checking OpenGL errors, and initializing texture parameters.

classes.name: GLToolbox
classes.description: Utility class for handling OpenGL ES 2.0 shader compilation, program linking, error checking, and texture parameter initialization.

methods.name: loadShader
methods.description: Creates and compiles a shader of the given type from source code. Throws RuntimeException if compilation fails.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Links a vertex shader and fragment shader into an OpenGL program. Throws RuntimeException if linking fails.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Checks for OpenGL errors and throws a RuntimeException if any are found.

methods.name: initTexParams
methods.description: Initializes common texture parameters for 2D textures, setting filters and wrap modes.
